rules.description: Warlocks require a relationship to bargained power.
rules.explanation: Warlock evidence comes from a negotiated source, not automatic visible demons.

rules.description: Clerics require a witnessed sacred obligation source.
rules.explanation: Cleric power is tied to responsibility and witness.

rules.description: Fighters should not receive automatic aura language.
rules.explanation: Fighter readability should come through training and action.

rules.description: Full apparition requires explicit high-risk selection.
rules.explanation: Visible patrons must not be default.

rules.description: Profession must influence the primary tool.
rules.explanation: Profession is first-class and must change handling/tool read.
